scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:stories && npm run build
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData -packageAuthorizationProvider netrc CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build && node scripts/check-ios-bundle.js ios/DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/App.app
scripts.ios:archive: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination "generic/platform=iOS" -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData -archivePath ios/DerivedData/Archives/PathsOfWonder.xcarchive -packageAuthorizationProvider netrc CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO archive && node scripts/check-ios-bundle.js ios/DerivedData/Archives/PathsOfWonder.xcarchive/Products/Applications/App.app --release
scripts.ios:test:purchases: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme Purchases -configuration Debug -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro" -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData -packageAuthorizationProvider netrc -test-timeouts-enabled YES -default-test-execution-time-allowance 30 -maximum-test-execution-time-allowance 60 CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- test
